Nah, not nice at all.
Aug 2022
Friend was waiting for me here, arrived to a lot of meat cooked and ready to eat! Wasn't exactly in the mood for the mountain of meat, but hey hoo .....

Problem was the meat, of all kinds and all parts of the body (it looked like) just wasn't that nice......all mixed together, just throw it all on the barbie and it might work out ok.........except it didn't.... bits of a liver here, a bit of a rasher there, some fish, some ribs....I don't know, ha ha..... 
some of it was well rubbery too. 

No vegetables to sweeten the meat or lighten the load going down the hatch.

Nah, not nice at all.

Restaurant was packed, that is until midday sleeping time, I never seen a place empty as fast. We were the last out the door....ha ha

Different dining experience!
Jul 2019 • Family
We were literally walking past and saw the restaurant was very busy. Without any research we decided to go in. Turns out we were lucky to get a table as generally reservations are required. We were seated around a table with a bbq in the centre. So here is how it works. You pay a fixed price per head for all you can eat from the menu. Drinks not included. There is seafood, pork, beef and you can also order pasta, salad and pizza. Basically you pace yourself and enjoy the experience of cooking your food just as you like it.

Dinner Buffet at Hana Mạc Đĩnh Chi street
Jun 2018 • Couples
If you want to have a buffet at Hana, need to take reservations at least 2 days before, cause this restaurant always fully booking.
which the price a about 280.000 vnd/person (not included tax and drinks), this is most cheapest price I never saw before. 
Have a lot options for food: pastas, pizza, salad, seafood (salmon, oysters, scallop, seabass, mussels, shrimp, octopus....), meat (chicken, pork ribs - belly, beef.....) and they have desert which ice cream, caramel cake and agar agar.
Every thing you need to do just take a seat and order with the waitress, they will bring exactly the food you ordered to your table. 
When i get there, waitress very busy to serving their customers, so their faces not good, but when you understood them, they will so nice with you. 
My waiter is a tall boy, black skin and not always smile, but he very good at his service and so nice
Highly recommended to go and enjoy...!!

reviews.review_text:
Hocha
London, United Kingdom447 contributions
0
Fun Korean BBQ experience!
Dec 2017 • Family
This was a fun and different dining experience for us as the only Europeans there - the staff speak the bare minimum of English, but are lovely and keen to please regardless. We soon gathered that although it’s not a serve yourself buffet, it’s a fixed price per person and you order what you fancy from the menu and barbecue it yourself at the table using the built in coal pit. Everything was delicious and top quality, whether meat, seafood or fish. The price is incredible at under £10 a head. Only downsides: warm beer (if you’re not into diluting it with ice) and extremely noisy upstairs - although it’s clearly very popular and on this occasion it added to the ambience.
